caption: The drawing depicts a simplified botanical design composed of several colored elements enclosed in a rectangular border. Dominating the central portion is a large, arched green form with black dots, resembling a curved leaf or stem, spanning from the lower left to the lower right corners and arching upward. Emerging from the center of this arch is a plant with a straight green stem dividing into two smaller stems; one leads to a large, red and pale orange flower with two red petals and a yellowish-orange petal. Three green leaves, each with black dots, extend from the main stem. To the left and right of the central arch, two tall, straight vertical red shapes with bulbous tops are positioned at the edges of the drawing, resembling stylized red flowers or candle flames. The background features a pattern of light, scalloped lines in blue, forming a repetitive, overlapping arc pattern behind the main elements. The entire composition is set within a double black-line rectangular border, and the drawing is signed with "Margaret Lesley" in the bottom right corner.
title: Quilt
